items.title: What + Water Does
items.why: Now, each tap of + Water at the top of Nutrition adds 8 oz with no sign anything happened, because the water count is far down the page. Pick what a tap should do instead. Either way, nothing is added until you tap +8 or +16 yourself.

now.caption: Now: + Water at the top adds 8 oz silently

options.label: A · Open a water sheet
options.desc: A small sheet with today's total, the glasses and −8 / +8 / +16. Done closes it. Works like + Food, and you never lose your place.

options.label: B · Jump to the water card
options.desc: The page scrolls down to the Water card and outlines it for a moment, so you can tap +8 there.
